purpose: Establish the current-f01e AutoRound TP4/MTP0/eager/F16 exact-8K target-only oracle parent on all four B70s. Freeze the TP4 output when exact depth, objective quality, identity, rank-cache isolation, and cleanup pass. Record frozen current-f01e TP1/MTP0 token parity and TP1 baseline agreement as conservative comparison grades, not prerequisites for the separate same-topology TP4 oracle.

prior_evidence.tp_scale_basis: Historical TP4 AutoRound controls prove this four-card topology can boot, but they used older runtime or graph identities and provide no current-f01e eager oracle.
prior_evidence.current_image_scope: Current-f01e TP1 MTP0/eager/F16 exact 8K and full quality are frozen. Token equality across TP1 and TP4 is a conservative empirical gate, never assumed.

rank_cache_basis.contract: vLLM compilation caches are rank-namespaced as rank_<rank>_0; graph-off should create no compile artifacts, otherwise all artifacts must be isolated across ranks 0-3 with no shared files.

reopen_basis: TP4 speculative coverage requires a same-image, same-topology target-only oracle. This bounded exact-8K parent supplies it without altering any historical result.

target_oracle.gate: Compare all 128 TP4 candidate token IDs with the frozen TP1 target-only IDs. This is a conservative same-image cross-topology comparison, never inferred and not a TP4-oracle prerequisite. A mismatch creates an explicit lower-grade caveat and does not invalidate either topology.

quality_contract.objective_pass: quality.json pass_all: seven exact cases, eight-repeat one-hash determinism, 8K needle, and cache zero
quality_contract.comparison_grade: quality.json baseline_match_all records all 24 TP1-baseline comparisons separately
quality_contract.gate: Objective quality pass_all is required after exact 8K. baseline_match_all is retained as a conservative cross-topology comparison; a false value creates a lower-grade caveat but does not prevent freezing the same-topology TP4 oracle.

terminal_classification.passed-quality-clean-tp4-oracle-sentinel: All four workers, exact depth, objective quality, TP1 token comparison, TP1 baseline comparison, graph-off identity, rank-cache isolation, and cleanup pass; freeze the candidate as the separate TP4 oracle.
terminal_classification.passed-quality-clean-tp4-oracle-with-com: All TP4-native prerequisites pass, but TP1 token parity or TP1 baseline agreement differs. Freeze the candidate as a lower-grade same-topology TP4 oracle with the exact comparison caveat recorded.
terminal_classification.quarantined-objective-quality-failed: Exact TP4 8K passes but objective quality.json pass_all is false; retain diagnostic evidence without freezing an oracle.
terminal_classification.quarantined-exact-depth-failed: The exact 8K request fails; retain its lower-grade diagnostic receipt without promotion or descendant authority.
terminal_classification.failed: Infrastructure/startup, worker topology, identity, rank-cache isolation, request, verification generation, or cleanup failure; preserve all raw evidence.

target_only_contract.oracle_role: If fully passed, this exact output becomes the frozen same-topology TP4 MTP0 oracle for later TP4 MTP1-4.

cache_contract.policy: vLLM rank_<rank>_0 namespaces under one fresh ext4 root; graph-off expects no compile artifacts, otherwise require all four rank namespaces and no shared compile files
